date.as_written: śambho rāri śārādharādharārākātithau mitraje | māse māghamaghe ca śobhanayute kuṃbhe ca siṃhe ʼrjune

notes: The colophon contains a metrical date with an obscure/corrupt chronogram and astrological positions (Sun in Aquarius, Moon in Leo with Maghā nakṣatra). The verse mentions that someone copied the text ('... asau lekhe mahadbuddhimān'), but the text preceding it contains a lacuna and unclear syllables ('/// prādā, siṃhānaktasa...'), leaving no identifiable personal name.
